_hinweis: Notice on empty story pages: in game language, what the situation is. “Nothing yet …” when the page can fill up; “Coming soon” when the feature is missing. No sentences about the origin or accuracy of the data. Keys: leer.<ID of the view as in the menu>. No placeholders. A notice only names senders and occasions that an active rule actually produces (aktive_regeln in zustand.json).
